prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a refined professional MONOCHROME grayscale layout study, not a finished color design, showing only a GISBA unified commercial chat panel for an agency homepage hero. Output desktop horizontal image 1440x1000. This is an illustrated proposed layout, NOT literal GISBA product screenshot. Front-facing, no perspective, no phones or laptop, no homepage nav, no advertisement inserted, no CTA. Elegant white/off-white background, crisp charcoal DM Sans/Manrope style, soft gray bubbles, hairline separators and subtle restrained shadow. Avoid huge empty margins, oversized gray avatars, excessive boxes and repeated labels. It must look thoughtfully designed for a website rather than an admin-dashboard screenshot.
Above panel small kicker "PROPUESTA DE LAYOUT · ESCRITORIO"; clear heading "La conversación y su próximo paso, juntos.".
Main panel width1280 height690, thin header title "GISBA · Conversaciones", small badge "Ejemplo ilustrativo".
Two columns: 65% main chat, 35% compact opportunity context, only one divider. No left inbox list in this composition.
Main chat header small understated circle C, "Consulta de un restaurante", second line "Atiende tu equipo comercial". A dark-gray outlined current stage pill "Cotización enviada" at right of this chat header. Clear left/right chat alignment with natural message proportions, large readable exact text:
Incoming left label "Cliente", bubble "Hola, necesito vajilla para mi restaurante."
Outgoing right label "Tu equipo", bubble "Te comparto la cotización para que revises las opciones."
Attached document aligned exactly under outgoing message, not floating over it. Small line document icon and text "Cotización de ejemplo", tiny subtext "Documento ilustrativo". Attachment integral to outgoing bubble.
Incoming left "Gracias, la revisaré y les aviso."
Composer at bottom "Escribe un mensaje…" with thin send icon only.
Right context panel simple editorial rows rather than many cards:
Top title "Esta oportunidad"
"Origen del ejemplo" / "Anuncio de Instagram"
"Interés" / "Vajilla para restaurante"
"Estado" / "Esperando decisión"
Below separated clearly one highlighted light-gray action area "Próximo paso" / "Dar seguimiento a la cotización". Small helper "A cargo de tu equipo comercial". NO date, scheduler, reminder, automation, robot or additional functions.
Bottom outside panel a very small caption "Recreación propuesta · No es una captura del producto."
No fake sales achieved, results, metrics, prices, personal identities, contact data, channel logos, integrations, bot automation or guaranteed attribution. Origin example is fictitious context only, not an integration assertion. Main focus the conversation and document, next step secondary but clear. All Spanish exact readable correct spelling. No repetition of stage elsewhere. Use restrained depth, substantially refined proportions compared to large flat previous UI. Grayscale only: layout selection is still pending.
